g.text: Each bar is what was measured at that commit, in that session; this laptop throttles, so only same-session comparisons are exact.
The last bar is today's back-to-back figure. 80× overall, on a 15 W laptop doing AES on every byte — and the remaining gap to the
dashed line is the far-end receiver, not this machine. Log scale: every step is legible, but the size of the win is flattened.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U (16 threads) · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
